P10-013 is re-resolved as MOVE (its prose grounds the row's existence — the inclusio — and the survey rule, not a ground for LOW). The three siblings the check blocked on the same reading (P01-001, P01-014, P02-006) were raised by no reviewer and are NOT re-reviewed here; they are routed to the orchestrator under T-3 for the same text check.
